claims.text: Stripe Minions run on pre-warmed AWS devboxes that are ready in about 10 seconds.
Stripe's Minions devboxes are quarantined, so agents run with broad permissions without confirmation prompts.
Stripe's Minions agent is a fork of Block's goose, adapted for unattended operation.
Stripe blueprints mix deterministic nodes (such as linting and pushing) with agentic nodes (such as implementation and fixing CI failures).
Stripe's Toolshed MCP server has nearly 500 tools, and each agent gets a curated subset of them.
Minions typically get one or two CI rounds before handing off to a human.
Stripe's Minions produce over 1,300 merged PRs per week.
